name: EnableUser Accessibility Widget
description: Scan a single page or crawl same-site links (configurable max URLs and crawl depth) against WCAG 2.1 AA, IS 17802 (Ch 7 / 9 / 10 / 12 / 13), EN 301 549, Section 508, and ADA Title III using axe-core plus India-specific and IS 17802 site-governance checks. Audits linked PDF and Office (docx/xlsx/pptx) documents for structural accessibility. Produces a CSV report, scope docx, and component inventory.
